# Killian Chiao

> Founder and product builder. Born on the Arctic Circle, raised between
> Switzerland and Northern Norway. Work spans behavioural science, product
> and brand, with clients including Coca-Cola, IKEA, KPMG, T-Mobile,
> L'Oreal and Mercedes.

This is a plain-text version of https://killianchiao.com intended for AI
agents and other automated readers. The HTML site carries the same
information in a designed layout.

## Biography

**Early childhood.** Born in Mo i Rana, Norway, on the Arctic Circle, to a
Norwegian state conflict mediator mother who worked with terrorists and
criminals, and a Swiss-French father in Swiss investment banking. The first
five years were spent in the French-speaking part of Switzerland, between
Geneva and Lausanne, before moving to Northern Norway.

**Early teenage virtual hotelier.** In the early 2000s, started a first
online venture selling virtual furniture in Habbo Hotel, one of the world's
first massively multiplayer games — effectively the first virtual currency
exchangeable for real money.

**India: United World College.** Selected by the Norwegian National
Committee of UWC from a highly competitive pool of applicants, and awarded a
full scholarship sponsored by the Red Cross to attend the Mahindra United
World College of India. The UWC movement was the birthplace of the
International Baccalaureate programme.

**Arctic innovation in Svalbard.** Featured in Svalbardposten for
contributing ideas to sustainable building projects in Longyearbyen, the
world's northernmost settlement, as Innovation Norway explored how the
Arctic town could become a testbed for building in extreme conditions.

**Swiss hospitality education.** Featured in Swissinfo's coverage of EHL
(Ecole hôtelière de Lausanne), the Swiss school for hotel managers.

**Zario: EU-Startups pitch winner.** Zario won the EU-Startups Summit 2023
Pitch Competition and its €150,000 grand prize. The app helps people build a
healthier relationship with their phones by making screen-time reduction
feel like a game rather than a punishment.

## Career

**Art Basel — Senior Product Manager, App (current).** Leads AI-powered
mobile experiences including the Art Basel Companion and Lens, building
personalised fair navigation and artwork discovery for collectors and
primary-market galleries. Work spans AI-driven matching, recommendation
engines and high-end consumer product design.

**Zario — Co-Founder & CEO (2022–2025).** AI digital wellbeing product that
reached close to one million users across its product suite, with around 20
employees globally at peak and close to $1M raised. Exited to an app
portfolio company in 2025. Product work was rooted in behaviour-change
design drawing on CBT and ACT principles: retention systems and
anti-cheating mechanics, social and group accountability loops, family
challenge concepts, AI-assisted validation, and brand-funded rewards
marketplace experiments.

**MissionPossible.VC — Investor (2025–).** Early-stage investing with a
founder-operator lens.

**Studio Hue — Co-Founder.** Video and animation agency serving enterprise
clients including Coca-Cola and IKEA.

**WDHB Strategic Learning — Global Program Manager.** Designed executive
learning experiences for C-suite leaders at Fortune 500 companies; converted
a Swiss Life discovery insight on failure culture into a multi-year contract.

**Earlier career.** Finance, sales and marketing, hospitality and operations
roles at Hathor Investment Group, Philip Morris International, WWF, Borgo
Egnazia, Base7booking, BARVIKHA HOTEL&SPA, and Barn & Familieteamet.

## Expertise

AI/ML product management, technical product management, UX design,
stakeholder management, customer engagement, digital strategy and
transformation, storytelling, marketing. Hands-on with Python, FastAPI,
vector embeddings, MCP, AWS and Azure.

## Education & Languages

BS in International Business, EHL Hospitality Business School. Additional
study through Stanford Online / Y Combinator and Wharton (Viral Marketing).
Native or bilingual in English and Norwegian (Bokmål). Based in Zurich,
Switzerland.
